description: End-to-end training launch from a git repo and init script. Use when the user wants a repo trained on a GPU in one step rather than orchestrating create + poll themselves. Called without a plan_id it only *prepares* a launch plan — the canonical spec, a cost estimate and an approval URL — and nothing is allocated or billed. Executing needs that plan_id, approved by the user; confirm:true expresses intent and never substitutes for approval. Executing starts hourly billing, waits up to wait_timeout_seconds for the instance to reach running, and returns connection details plus a log tail. Repeating the execute call with the same plan_id returns the same job; it never launches a second.

confirm.description: Intent to launch. Launching also needs plan_id, approved by the user

plan_id.description: The plan a call without it prepared. Executes only once the user has approved it

name: run_training_job
title: Run a training job
